item.title: Re: Nested collapsibles
item.content:encoded: Just copy the code we used. No CSS needed.

item.title: Nested collapsibles
item.content:encoded: I must bring up the obvious question: How do you guys manage to have nested collapsibles? I could really use something like that.

item.title: Re: Do they?
item.content:encoded: Nah, just for missions, when they have to build a new habitat. It is otherwise to valuable to use.

item.title: Do they?
item.content:encoded: Do they use it normally or on missions?

What is an INT article?
Articles with the INT designations are cross-branch collaborations between members of at least two branches which both must have played a significant part in the article's creation. See here for more info and here for more INT articles. Of course, INT articles are also possible involving members of the English wiki.
